meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 给你的 NanoClaw 装上 iMessage 渠道:复制适配器、注册导入、装 chat-adapter-imessage@0.1.1,再按本地或远程 Photon 模式写好凭证,并重启服务生效。
howto.when: 当你提到 “add imessage”、“connect imessage”、“add photon” 等说法,或要求给 NanoClaw 接入 iMessage 渠道时触发。

howto.what_en: Adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw: copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers the import, installs chat-adapter-imessage@0.1.1, writes local or Photon credentials, and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon" and similar, or ask to wire iMessage into NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add iMessage to NanoClaw in local mode
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and walks you through Full Disk Access.
Asks for your Photon server URL and API key.

say_en.text: Check whether the iMessage channel is wired up
say_en.note: Runs the registration test and restarts the service.
